blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Real-time polyp segmentation in computer-assisted colonoscopy is hampered by the difficulty of deploying high-accuracy models under strict latency budgets. Frame skipping, which performs inference every K frames and reuses or interpolates the rest, improves throughput but introduces motion blur and lesion misalignment that degrade temporal consistency. To close this gap, we propose the Lightweight Frame Compensator (LFC), a 77K-parameter plug-and-play module inserted before a frozen segmentation backbone. Operating on a three-frame window, LFC fuses consecutive frames via spatio-temporal attention into a single compensated frame, and is trained only on pseudo-labels generated by a differently seeded model, without any expert annotation. Experiments on three polyp video benchmarks show that LFC recovers most of the accuracy degraded by direct frame skipping and, in several settings, reaches the accuracy of frame-by-frame inference, while retaining a 2.05X--2.55X throughput gain. We further evaluate the temporal stability of three backbones spanning CNN, pyramid Transformer, and global-attention Transformer architectures, revealing a spectrum of sensitivity to frame skipping that arises from how locally or globally each architecture aggregates misaligned input. The compensation gain of LFC follows this spectrum: it is largest for high-capacity Transformer backbones, which achieve the best static accuracy but suffer the most under skip-frame inference. LFC thus offers a lightweight, pluggable, and deployment-friendly route to real-time polyp segmentation.
blocks.zh: 计算机辅助结肠镜学中的实时多肽分解由于在严格的潜伏预算下难以部署高精度模型而受到阻碍. 框架跳过,它进行每个 K 帧的推论,再利用或插入其余部分,可以提高吞吐量,但引入运动模糊和损害错位,从而降低时间一致性。 为了缩小这一差距,我们提议使用轻量级框架补偿器(LFC),即一个77K参数的插座和游戏模块插入到一个冷冻的分块主干线之前。 LFC在一个三帧窗口上运行,通过斯皮提奥时段的注意将连续的帧线导入一个单一的补偿帧线,并且只接受不同种子模型产生的伪标签培训,没有任何专家注释. 对三个多盘视频基准的实验表明,LFC恢复了大部分通过直接帧跳过而退化的精度,并在一些情况下达到了帧逐帧推断的精度,同时保留了2.05X-2.55X的吞吐量增益. 我们进一步评价横跨CNN、金字塔变形器和全球关注变形器架构的三个主干网的时间稳定性, 揭示出从地方或全球各架构如何聚集错位输入而跳过框架的敏感度。 LFC的补偿收益遵循这个频谱:它对于大容量变形器骨干来说是最大的,它们能达到最好的静态精度,但在跳过框架推论下受的伤害最大. 因此,LFC提供了一个轻量级、可插接和部署友好的路线,可通往实时多肽分解。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Colorectal cancer remains one of the most prevalent and lethal malignancies worldwide, with a substantial proportion of cases arising from the malignant transformation of colorectal polyps [ 18 ] . Colonoscopy serves as the primary screening modality for these polyps, enabling direct visualization of lesion morphology and facilitating resection during the same procedure [ 20 , 5 ] . However, the intricate anatomy of the colon, characterized by complex fold patterns and frequent luminal occlusion, contributes to non-negligible miss rates even in expert hands. While recent work has explored image classification and object detection techniques to assist real-time video interpretation [ 1 , 16 , 22 , 17 ] , polyp segmentation offers a more granular level of assistance: it supplies pixel-level location and contour information, provides richer visual cues for intra-operative resection, and enables models to learn deeper pixel-wise representations that can benefit downstream diagnostic tasks [ 10 ] . Accurate and timely polyp segmentation is therefore essential for the early detection and management of colorectal cancer.
blocks.zh: 结肠癌仍然是全世界最普遍和致命的恶性肿瘤之一,很大比例的病例是结肠性多发性疾病的恶性转化[18]. 凝胶检查是这些多肽的主要筛选方式,可以直接视像损伤形态,便于在同一过程中重新剖开[20,5]。 然而,结肠的复杂的解剖学,其特点是折叠模式复杂,且经常露天闭塞,这种解剖法甚至在专家手中也造成了不可忽略的误差率。 虽然最近的工作探索了图像分类和物体检测技术以协助实时视频解析[1,16,22,17],但多肽分解提供了更微粒级的帮助:它提供像素级位置和轮廓信息,为手术内切除提供了更丰富的视觉提示,使模型能够学习更深的像素级表达,有利于下游的诊断任务[10]. 因此,准确和及时的多肽分解对于早期发现和管理结肠癌至关重要。

blocks.en: Nevertheless, polyp segmentation remains a challenging task. Polyps frequently exhibit indistinct boundaries and highly variable size, shape, and color distribution, endowing them with strong camouflage characteristics [ 15 ] . Traditional manual segmentation depends on the clinician’s subjective experience and sustained attention, resulting in limited inter-observer consistency. Early computer-assisted methods predominantly exploited low-level features such as shape, texture, or color; although computationally efficient, their accuracy and robustness proved insufficient when the contrast between polyps and surrounding mucosa is low [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,多层分割仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。 Polyps经常表现出模糊的界限和高度可变的大小、形状和颜色分布,使其具有强烈的伪装特征[15]。 传统的人工分割取决于临床医生的主观经验和持续的关注,导致观察者之间的一致性有限. 早期的计算机辅助方法主要利用诸如形状、纹理或颜色等低级特征;虽然计算效率高,但当多肽类和周围黏液的对比度低[3]时,其准确性和稳健性证明不足。

blocks.en: In recent years, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have become the dominant paradigm in polyp segmentation, with U-Net standing out as the most representative architecture [ 19 ] . More recently, Transformer-based backbones have been introduced to this field and quickly became a strong alternative: TransUNet, which integrates self-attention into a U-shaped encoder–decoder framework, consistently outperforms its CNN counterparts on multiple polyp benchmarks [ 7 ] , and task-specific designs such as Polyp-PVT [ 9 ] further push the accuracy frontier. However, the accuracy advantage of Transformer-based models comes with markedly higher computational overhead and latency, which poses a severe challenge for real-time deployment, where high frame-rate processing is required.
blocks.zh: 近年来,进化神经网络(CNNs)成为多肽分解中的主导范式,U-Net是最具代表性的架构[19]. 最近,基于变形器的骨干被引入到这个领域,并很快成为了强大的替代品: TransUNet将自我注意整合到U形的编码器-解码器框架中,在多种多普基准[7]上一贯优于CNN对应方,而Polyp-PVT[9]等特定任务设计进一步推高精度前沿. 然而,基于变形器的模型的准确性优势是计算间接费用和耐久性明显提高,这对实时部署构成严重挑战,因为实时部署需要高帧率处理。

blocks.en: Meanwhile, real-time surgical video segmentation is not confined to colonoscopy polyp segmentation; it represents a broader clinical and engineering domain encompassing laparoscopic surgery, robotic-assisted intervention, and other video-guided procedures. At the system deployment level, a widely adopted strategy to improve GPU throughput, whether for multi-channel video streams or high-frame-rate processing, is frame skipping : rather than executing the full segmentation model on every frame, inference is performed every K K frames, with the remaining frames filled by reuse or interpolation. This strategy can substantially increase throughput, but it introduces motion blur and lesion misalignment in segments involving rapid motion, instrument occlusion, or abrupt morphological changes, degrading temporal consistency and compromising real-time performance.
blocks.zh: 同时,实时外科视频分解并不局限于结肠镜多肽分解;它是一个更广泛的临床和工程领域,包括脑膜外科手术、机器人辅助干预和其他视频指导程序。 在系统部署层面,一个广泛采用的改善GPU吞吐量的战略,无论是多通道视频流还是高帧速率处理,都跳过帧 : 而不是在每个帧上执行完整的分割模型,推论是每个K K帧进行,其余帧通过再利用或插值填充. 这项战略可大幅度提高吞吐量,但它在涉及快速运动、仪器掩塞或突然形态变化、降低时间一致性和损害实时性能的片段引入运动模糊和损伤错位。

blocks.en: This problem is particularly pronounced for Transformer-based architectures. Unlike CNNs, whose convolution kernels inherently provide local spatial smoothing, Transformer models rely on self-attention with a global receptive field. Patch-level misalignments introduced by frame skipping propagate globally through attention, causing more severe frame-to-frame prediction jitter. Despite this, to our knowledge, no prior work has systematically quantified the temporal stability of different architectural families, from CNNs to pyramid and global-attention Transformers, under frame-skipping inference, nor has any lightweight compensation scheme been proposed to address the resulting accuracy loss.
blocks.zh: 这个问题对于基于变形器的建筑来说尤为突出. 与CNN的演化内核本质上能提供局部空间平滑不同,变形器模型依赖于带有全球可接受域的自觉. 由帧跳过而引入的补丁级错配通过注意力在全球传播,导致更严重的帧对帧预测紧张. 尽管如此,据我们所知,从有线电视新闻网到金字塔和全球关注的变形器等不同建筑家族的时间稳定性没有系统地量化,也没有提出任何轻量级补偿计划来解决由此产生的准确性损失。

blocks.en: To tackle these issues, this paper makes the following contributions:
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,本文件提出了以下意见:

blocks.en: • We propose the Lightweight Frame Compensator (LFC). LFC is a plug-and-play module with only ∼ \sim 77K parameters, inserted before a frozen segmentation backbone. Taking a window of three consecutive frames as input, it fuses them into a single compensated frame via spatio-temporal attention. Under a one-inference-per-three-frames regime, LFC recovers most of the accuracy loss caused by frame skipping and, in several settings, matches the accuracy of frame-by-frame inference, while being trained solely on pseudo-labels from a differently seeded model without any expert annotation. • We achieve a better efficiency–accuracy trade-off. With a negligible increase of 0.07M parameters, LFC retains a 2.05 × \times –2.55 × \times throughput gain over per-frame inference while substantially improving segmentation accuracy under frame skipping, providing a lightweight, pluggable, and deployment-friendly solution for real-time colonoscopy polyp segmentation. • We systematically evaluate the temporal stability of three backbones under frame skipping. Spanning a CNN, a pyramid Transformer, and a global-attention Transformer, our analysis shows that the compensation gain of LFC is governed by two factors: the sensitivity of the backbone to frame-to-frame jitter artifacts, measured by the per-video standard deviation of frame-wise predictions, and the accuracy of the backbone itself. This spectrum explains why high-capacity Transformer models, despite their superior static accuracy, benefit from LFC the most.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提议采用轻量级框架补偿法。 LFC是一个插件和游戏模块,只有 \\\sim 77K 参数,插入在冷冻分块主干之前. 采用连续三帧的窗口作为输入,它通过时空的注意将它们融合到一个单一的补偿框架中. 在每三帧一推法制度下,LFC回收了帧跳动造成的大部分精度损失,并在若干情况下与帧逐帧推论的精度相符,同时只接受来自不同种子模型的伪标签培训,而没有任何专家注释。 我们实现了更好的效率-准确性权衡。 LFC在可忽略的0.07M参数增加的情况下,保留了2.05×\时 –2.55×\时 吞吐量从每帧推算得到的增益,同时在帧跳动下大幅度提高分解精度,为实时结肠镜多分解提供轻量级,可插插合型和部署友好型解决方案. ^ 我们系统地评估了框架跳过的三个骨干的时间稳定性。 我们的分析显示 LFC的补偿收益 由两个因素决定: 骨干对帧到帧的触动文物的敏感度, 以每段画面的标准偏差 来测量帧的预测, 以及骨干本身的准确度。 这个谱系解释了为什么高容量变形器模型尽管其优异的静态精度,却从LFC受益最大.

blocks.en: We propose the Lightweight Frame Compensator (LFC). LFC is a plug-and-play module with only ∼ \sim 77K parameters, inserted before a frozen segmentation backbone. Taking a window of three consecutive frames as input, it fuses them into a single compensated frame via spatio-temporal attention. Under a one-inference-per-three-frames regime, LFC recovers most of the accuracy loss caused by frame skipping and, in several settings, matches the accuracy of frame-by-frame inference, while being trained solely on pseudo-labels from a differently seeded model without any expert annotation.
blocks.zh: 我们提议采用轻量级框架补偿法。 LFC是一个插件和游戏模块,只有 \\\sim 77K 参数,插入在冷冻分块主干之前. 采用连续三帧的窗口作为输入,它通过时空的注意将它们融合到一个单一的补偿框架中. 在一个每三帧一推论制度下,LFC回收了帧跳过造成的大部分精度损失,并在一些场合与帧逐帧推论的精度相匹配,同时只接受来自不同种子模型的伪标签培训而没有任何专家注释.

blocks.en: We achieve a better efficiency–accuracy trade-off. With a negligible increase of 0.07M parameters, LFC retains a 2.05 × \times –2.55 × \times throughput gain over per-frame inference while substantially improving segmentation accuracy under frame skipping, providing a lightweight, pluggable, and deployment-friendly solution for real-time colonoscopy polyp segmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们实现了更好的效率-准确性权衡。 LFC可忽略不计地增加0.07M参数,保留了2.05x\times –2.55x\times的吞吐量在每帧推论的基础上增益,同时在帧跳动下大幅提高分解精度,为实时结肠多片分解提供了轻量级,插合型和部署友好型解决方案.

blocks.en: We systematically evaluate the temporal stability of three backbones under frame skipping. Spanning a CNN, a pyramid Transformer, and a global-attention Transformer, our analysis shows that the compensation gain of LFC is governed by two factors: the sensitivity of the backbone to frame-to-frame jitter artifacts, measured by the per-video standard deviation of frame-wise predictions, and the accuracy of the backbone itself. This spectrum explains why high-capacity Transformer models, despite their superior static accuracy, benefit from LFC the most.
blocks.zh: 我们系统地评估了框架跳过的三个骨干的时间稳定性。 我们的分析显示 LFC的补偿收益 由两个因素决定: 骨干对帧到帧的触动文物的敏感度, 以每段画面的标准偏差 来测量帧的预测, 以及骨干本身的准确度。 这个谱系解释了为什么高容量变形器模型尽管其优异的静态精度,却从LFC受益最大.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Problem formulation and overall framework
blocks.zh: 2.1 问题的拟订和总体框架

blocks.en: Given an endoscopic video sequence, we adopt a fixed skip-frame interval K = 3 K=3 , i.e., the segmentation backbone is invoked only once every three consecutive frames. We fix K = 3 K=3 as it is the most widely adopted skip-frame interval in real-time endoscopic deployment and matches the three-frame window of LFC; the effect of larger K is left for future work.
blocks.zh: 鉴于内视视频序列,我们采用固定的跳线间隔 K = 3 K = 3 ,即区段主干器每连续三个帧只引用一次. 我们固定 K = 3 K = 3,因为它是实时内视部署中最广泛采用的跳伞间隔,与 LFC 的三帧窗口相匹配;更大的 K 的效果留给未来工作。

blocks.en: Denote the input window as { 𝐱 t − 1 , 𝐱 t , 𝐱 t + 1 } ∈ ℝ B × 3 × 3 × H × W \{\mathbf{x}_{t-1},\mathbf{x}_{t},\mathbf{x}_{t+1}\}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times 3\times 3\times H\times W} , where B B is the batch size, C = 3 C=3 the RGB channels, and T = 3 T=3 the temporal dimension. The proposed LFC takes this window as input and generates a single compensated frame 𝐱 ~ t ∈ ℝ B × 3 × H × W \tilde{\mathbf{x}}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times 3\times H\times W} , which is then fed into a frozen segmentation backbone for forward inference. Since LFC does not increase the invocation frequency of the backbone, the overall throughput remains comparable to direct skip-frame (DSF) inference.
blocks.zh: 注意输入窗口为 {x t − 1, x t , x t + 1 } { R B } 3 × 3 × H × W × mathbf{x}_{t-1},\mathbf{x}_{t},\mathbf{x}_{t+1}in\ mathbb{R}^{B\Times 3\Times 3\Times H\times W},其中B B为批量大小,C=3 C=3 RGB通道,T=3 T=3时间维度. 拟议的LFC将这个窗口作为输入并生成一个单独的补偿框架 x ~ t → R B × 3 × H × W\tilde\ mathbf{x}}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times 3\times H\times W},然后输入一个冷冻的区块主干线进行前推. 由于LFC不增加主干线的引用频率,总体吞吐量仍然与直接跳线(DSF)推论相当.

blocks.en: Unlike probability-level propagation methods that operate on segmentation outputs, LFC works in the input space: the compensated frame can be interpreted as a learned, content-adaptive estimate of the scene, constructed from a window that carries at least as much task-relevant information as any single observed frame.
blocks.zh: 与在分块输出上运行的概率级传播方法不同,LFC在输入空间工作:补偿框架可以被解释为对场景的有知识的,内容的适应性估计,从至少包含与任务相关的信息与任何单个观测框架一样的窗口构建.

blocks.en: 2.2 Experimental pipeline
blocks.zh: 2.2 实验管道

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , our training pipeline consists of three stages.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,我们的培训管道包括三个阶段。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Proposed pipeline and LFC model structure.
blocks.zh: 图 1:拟议的管道和LFC模型结构。

blocks.en: We first consolidate all publicly available expert-annotated polyp segmentation datasets into a unified mixed dataset, which serves as the development set for model training. In this stage, we report the segmentation performance of various baseline models trained with ground-truth annotations, which establishes the reference performance under the fully supervised setting.
blocks.zh: 我们首先将所有公开的专家附加说明的多段数据集合并为一个统一的混合数据集,作为模型培训的开发集. 在这一阶段,我们报告经过地面真实情况说明培训的各种基线模型的分解绩效,这些模型确定了在全面监督下的参照绩效。

blocks.en: Taking TransUNet as a representative example, we first employ a pretrained model (Seed A) as the pseudo-label generator to generate pseudo-labels for every frame of the continuous video frames in the VIM-Polyp and HyperKvasir datasets. Subsequently, we use another model (Seed B), pretrained under the fully supervised setting on the same mixed dataset but with a different random seed and a frozen backbone, to perform inference on both datasets. Since Seed A and Seed B share identical model architectures trained on the same mixed dataset with different seeds, we obtain two sets of results via the inference of Seed B: (i) the frame-by-frame (FBF) inference performance, and (ii) the performance of direct pixel-wise averaging over K K skipped frames, in which inference is performed once every three frames.
blocks.zh: 转录 UNet作为一个具有代表性的例子,我们首先使用预先训练过的模型(种子A)作为伪标签生成器,为VIM-Polyp和HyperKvasir数据集中连续视频帧的每一帧生成伪标签. 随后,我们使用另一个模型(种子B),在完全监督的设置下,在同一混合数据集上进行预先训练,但使用不同的随机种子和冷冻的骨干,对两个数据集进行推论. 自从种子A和种子 B分享在同一个混合数据集上经过不同种子训练的相同的模型架构,我们通过种子B的推论获得两套结果:(一) 逐帧推论性能(FBF),以及(二) 直接像素平均比K跳过帧的性能,每三帧一次进行推论.

blocks.en: On the VIM-Polyp dataset, we freeze the backbone of Seed B and insert the proposed LFC module in front of it, feeding three consecutive frames into the LFC module for training. Notably, throughout the entire LFC training process, the segmentation backbone remains frozen and receives no gradient updates. This design preserves the plug-and-play nature of the LFC module and ensures a fair comparison. Once the LFC module is trained, we evaluate the segmentation performance on both the VIM-Polyp test set and the HyperKvasir dataset. In this setting, the model still performs inference once every three frames; however, the inference is now conducted on LFC-compensated images reconstructed from three consecutive video frames. Through this stage, we verify whether the LFC module can enable skip-frame inference to achieve segmentation accuracy comparable to per-frame inference, while retaining a 2.05 × \times –2.55 × \times throughput improvement depending on the backbone.
blocks.zh: 在VIM-Polyp数据集上,我们冻结了种子B的主干,并在前方插入拟议的LFC模块,将连续三个帧输入LFC模块用于培训. 值得注意的是,在整个LFC培训过程中,分区主干仍然被冻结,没有收到梯度更新. 这种设计保留了LFC模块的插座和游戏性质,并确保了公平的比较. 一旦LFC模块得到训练,我们就在VIM-Polyp测试集和HyperKvasir数据集上评价分解性能. 在这个设定中,模型仍然每三帧进行一次推论;然而,现在的推论是在LFC补偿的图像上进行的,这些图像是从三个连续的视频帧中重建出来的. 通过这个阶段,我们验证LFC模块是否能够使跳过帧推论实现与每帧推论相仿的分解精度,同时保留一个2.05x\times–2.55x\times的吞吐量改进取决于主干.

blocks.en: 2.3 LFC architecture
blocks.zh: 2.3 LFC架构

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , LFC consists of three sequential components: a shared frame-wise feature extractor, a spatio-temporal attention estimator, and a multi-layer fusion head. The total parameter count is 77K.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,LFC由三个相继组成:一个共享帧式特征提取器,一个spatio-temporal注意力估计器,以及一个多层聚变头. 总参数计为77K.

blocks.en: Feature Extractor. The extractor ℱ ext \mathcal{F}_{\text{ext}} independently encodes each frame in the window using two 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional layers (each followed by batch normalization and ReLU), mapping the input from 3 channels to a 32-dimensional feature space. This yields a set of feature maps { 𝐟 t − 1 , 𝐟 t , 𝐟 t + 1 } \{\mathbf{f}_{t-1},\mathbf{f}_{t},\mathbf{f}_{t+1}\} , where 𝐟 ∈ ℝ B × 32 × H × W \mathbf{f}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times 32\times H\times W} . The extractor shares weights across the three frames to ensure computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 特质解剖器. 提取器Fext \ mathcal{F}_{\xext{ext}} 独立编码窗口中的每个帧,使用两个 3× 3 3\times 3 切换层(每个层之后是批量正常化和ReLU),将输入从3个信道映射到32维特性空间. 此生成一组特征地图 { f t − 1, f t → f t + 1} { mathbf { f}_{ t 1} ,\ mathbf { f}_{ t} ,\ mathbf { f}_{ t+1}\}} , 其中 f∈ R B × 32 × H× W → mathb{ f}\in\ mathbbb{ R}^{ B\ Times 32\ Times 32\ Times {\fn华文仿宋\fs16\1cHD1D1D1} 提取器在三个框架之间共享权重,以确保计算效率.

blocks.en: Spatio-Temporal Attention. The attention estimator ℱ attn \mathcal{F}_{\text{attn}} concatenates the three frame features along the channel dimension, producing 𝐟 cat ∈ ℝ B × 96 × H × W \mathbf{f}_{\text{cat}}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times 96\times H\times W} . After two 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional layers, it outputs a 3-channel spatial attention map 𝐀 ∈ ℝ B × 3 × H × W \mathbf{A}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times 3\times H\times W} , normalized by a Sigmoid function to ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) . The attention map adaptively weights the three frame features at the pixel level: 𝐟 fused = ∑ i = 1 3 𝐀 i ⊙ 𝐟 i , \mathbf{f}_{\text{fused}}=\sum_{i=1}^{3}\mathbf{A}_{i}\odot\mathbf{f}_{i}, (1) where 𝐀 i \mathbf{A}_{i} denotes the attention weight for the i i -th frame and ⊙ \odot is element-wise multiplication. This mechanism enables implicit motion compensation and noise suppression by allowing the network to decide, per pixel, which frame contributes most to the fused result.

blocks.en: Fusion Head. The fusion head ℱ fuse \mathcal{F}_{\text{fuse}} performs deep integration of the attended features. It employs three 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional layers with an intermediate channel expansion from 32 to 64 and subsequent compression back to 3 channels, followed by a Sigmoid activation to produce the compensated frame 𝐱 ~ t ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) B × 3 × H × W \tilde{\mathbf{x}}_{t}\in(0,1)^{B\times 3\times H\times W} . The multi-layer non-linear transformation allows the model to learn complex spatio-temporal feature interactions beyond simple linear averaging, and the Sigmoid guarantees that the output remains a valid image within the normalized intensity range.

blocks.en: 2.4 Training setup
blocks.zh: 2.4 培训设置

blocks.en: During training, the segmentation backbone (TransUNet, Polyp-PVT, or ResNet-UNet) is completely frozen; only the LFC parameters are updated via backpropagation. Supervision is provided by pseudo-labels generated from a frozen frame-by-frame (FBF) model on the video frames. The loss function is the standard Dice loss computed between the segmentation prediction of the compensated frame 𝐱 ~ t \tilde{\mathbf{x}}_{t} and the pseudo-label of the corresponding middle frame. This training strategy ensures that LFC learns general temporal priors rather than adapting to specific backbone parameters. Moreover, because the backbone requires no retraining, LFC can be directly deployed on any existing pre-trained segmentation model.
blocks.zh: 在训练期间,分化主干线(TransUNet,Polyp-PVT,或ResNet-UNet)被完全冻结;只有LFC参数通过反向传播更新. 监督由视频帧上冷冻帧模型产生的假标签提供。 损失函数是在对补偿框架x ~ t\ t\ tilde\ mathbf{x}}_{t} 和相应的中间框架的伪标签之间计算出的标准骰子损失 。 这一培训战略确保LFC学习一般时间前科,而不是适应特定的骨干参数. 此外,由于骨干不需要再培训,LFC可以直接部署在任何现有的预训分化模型上.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets and evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和评价衡量标准

blocks.en: This study constructs the development set using four publicly available polyp segmentation datasets with pixel-level gold-standard annotations: CVC-ClinicDB [ 4 ] , Kvasir-SEG [ 13 ] , PolypGen [ 2 ] , PolypDB [ 14 ] . Among them, CVC-ClinicDB and Kvasir-SEG are single-center, single-device datasets; PolypGen aggregates images from six medical centers; and PolypDB contains five imaging modalities (BLI, FICE, LCI, NBI, WLI) from three centers. We merge these four datasets into a unified development set and split them into training, validation, and test sets at a ratio of 7:1:2.
blocks.zh: 本研究使用四种可公开获取的多肽分解数据集构建开发集,并附有像素级金标准说明: CVC-ClinicDB [4],Kvasir-SEG [13], PolypGen [2], PolypDB [14]. 其中,CVC-ClinicDB和Kvasir-SEG是单中心,单设备数据集;PolypGen聚合了来自6个医疗中心的图像;PolypDB包含来自3个中心的5种成像模式(BLI,FICE,LCI,NBI,WLI). 我们把这四个数据集合并成一个统一的开发集,并按7:1:2. 的比例将其分为训练,验证,测试集.

blocks.en: BKAI-IGH [ 21 ] also provides ground-truth segmentation annotations, which we use as an external dataset to evaluate the robustness of the backbone model’s segmentation performance.
blocks.zh: BKAI-IGH [21] 也提供地面-真实分解说明,我们用它作为外部数据集来评价主干模型分解性能的稳健性.

blocks.en:
For the training of LFC, we adopt two colonoscopy video datasets: VIM-Polyp [ 8 ] for model training, HyperKvasir [ 6 ] and Colon-Bench [ 11 ] for external validation.
VIM-Polyp is an endoscopic video dataset without ground-truth segmentation annotations, comprising 133 video clips in total. We split it into training (79 clips), validation (13 clips), and test (41 clips) sets at a ratio of 6:1:3. Given the varying lengths of the videos, all frames are extracted and saved as individual images. The aforementioned methods, trained on reference datasets with gold-standard annotations, are then used to generate pseudo-labels for each frame, which serve as supervision targets for video training.
blocks.zh:
对于LFC的训练,我们采用两个结肠镜影视数据集:VIM-Polyp [8]用于模型训练,HyperKvasir [6]和Colon-Bench [11]用于外部验证.
VIM-Polyp是一个内景视频数据集,没有地面真实分解说明,共包含133个视频片段. 我们将其分为训练(79个片段),验证(13个片段),测试(41个片段),比例为6:1:3. 由于视频长度不同,所有帧都被提取出来并作为单个图像保存. 上述方法经过黄金标准说明的参考数据集培训后,用于制作每个帧的假标签,作为视频培训的监督目标。

blocks.en: For external validation, we adopt the polyp-labeled videos from the HyperKvasir dataset. We randomly select 5 videos and segment them into 5-second clips, yielding 125 video segments as the external validation set. As the continuous videos in HyperKvasir do not provide segmentation labels, we generate pseudo-labels for validation using Seed A of the same backbone model.
blocks.zh: 为了进行外部验证,我们采用了HyperKvasir数据集的多p标签视频。 我们随机选择5个视频,将其分解为5秒的片段,产生125个视频段作为外部验证集. 由于HyperKvasir中的连续视频不提供分区标签,我们用同一主干模型的种子A生成用于验证的伪标签.

blocks.en: For a second external validation, we adopt the polyp-labeled videos from the Colon-Bench dataset. We randomly select 8 polyp-labeled videos. Notably, the segmentation labels in Colon-Bench are AI-generated and subsequently verified by clinicians over continuous video sequences, making them a fully independent third-party standard that differs from VIM-Polyp and HyperKvasir. An overview of the datasets is provided in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 为了进行第二次外部验证,我们采用了Colon-Bench数据集的多p标签视频。 我们随机选择 8个多P标签的视频。 值得注意的是,Colon-Bench的分区标签是AI生成的,随后由临床医生通过连续的视频序列进行验证,使其成为一个完全独立的第三方标准,不同于VIM-Polyp和HyperKvasir. 数据集概况见表1。

3.2 Backbone models
blocks.zh: 3.2 后骨模型

blocks.en: This work compares three segmentation models that span the architectural spectrum from pure CNN to global self-attention: ResNet-UNet , a UNet with a ResNet-50 encoder [ 12 , 19 ] ; TransUNet , which replaces the encoder with a plain Vision Transformer (ViT) that operates on non-overlapping patches with a global self-attention mechanism [ 7 ] ; and Polyp-PVT [ 9 ] , a polyp-specific segmentation model built upon the Pyramid Vision Transformer. Unlike the plain ViT in TransUNet, which processes a single-scale sequence of hard-partitioned patches, PVTv2 introduces a pyramid structure with spatial-reduction attention, progressively shrinking the feature maps across stages and thereby retaining a degree of local spatial context. Polyp-PVT further equips this encoder with a lightweight decoder tailored to the challenges of polyp segmentation, such as indistinct boundaries and highly variable lesion scales.
blocks.zh: 这部作品比较了从纯有线电视新闻网到全球自觉的三种横跨建筑频谱的分区模型: ResNet-UNet,一个装有ResNet-50编码器的UNet [12, 19]; Trans UNet),它用一个平坦的视野变换器(ViT)取代编码器,在不重叠的补丁上运行,使用全球自留机制[7];和Polyp-PVT[9],一个基于金字塔视野变换器的多p特定分块模型. 与TransUNet的Plain ViT处理硬分块补丁的单级序列不同,PVTv2引入了具有空间缩小关注度的金字塔结构,逐步缩小各阶段的特征图,从而保留一定程度的局部空间环境. Polyp-PVT进一步为这个编码器配备了适合多肽分解挑战的轻量级解码器,如模糊的边界和高度可变的损伤尺度.

blocks.en: The encoders of all three models are pretrained on ImageNet. We deliberately select one representative per point on this spectrum—pure convolution (ResNet-UNet), pyramid multi-scale attention (Polyp-PVT), and global patch-based attention (TransUNet), so that the comparison of temporal stability under frame-skipping inference reflects architectural inductive biases rather than idiosyncrasies of a single model. All experiments were conducted on a single NVIDIA 5090 GPU under PyTorch. Each experiment was run three times with fixed random seeds, and the default setting is 352 × 352 352\times 352 resolution, batch size 4, Adam optimizer with learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , 100 epochs, and early stopping after 10 epochs without validation Dice improvement.
blocks.zh: 所有三种模型的编码器都在ImageNet上预训. 我们有意在这个光谱上每点挑选一名代表——纯粹的革命(ResNet-UNet)、金字塔式多尺度的注意(Polyp-PVT)和全球的补丁式注意(TransUNet),这样,在帧式推论下对时间稳定性的比较就反映出一种单一模型的建筑诱导性偏差,而不是特异性。 所有实验都是在PyTorch下的一个单NVIDIA 5090 GPU上进行的. 每一次实验都是用固定的随机种子进行三次,默认设置是352×352352\times 352分辨率,批量大小为4,亚当优化器的学习速率为3×10−4 3\times 10×4}100个纪元,10个纪元后提前停止,没有验证Dice改进.

blocks.en: For inference on a given video, we adopt frame-by-frame inference (FBF) as the accuracy upper bound. To mimic real-time deployment under limited computational budget, we consider a frame-skipping setting in which one inference is performed every three frames, i.e., each prediction covers a window of K = 3 K{=}3 consecutive frames { x t − 1 , x t , x t + 1 } \{x_{t-1},x_{t},x_{t+1}\} . Under this shared schedule, we compare LFC against three training-free fusion baselines.

blocks.en: These results confirm that the specialized model Polyp-PVT exhibits a clear advantage in polyp segmentation, while TransUNet, with its Transformer-based encoder, achieves competitive segmentation performance. In contrast, ResNet-UNet substantially underperforms both Transformer-based competing models in both internal testing and external zero-shot inference.
blocks.zh: 这些结果证实,专业模型Polyp-PVT在多肽分解中表现出明显的优势,而TransUNet以其变形器为基础的编码器则实现了竞争性分解性能. 相比之下,ResNet-UNet在内部测试和外部零射线推论中都大大低于基于变形器的竞争模型。

blocks.en: 3.4 Main results
blocks.zh: 3.4 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 3 shows that frame skipping severely degrades TransUNet, with the overall Dice dropping by 6.27 and 9.00 percentage points on VIM-Polyp and HyperKvasir, respectively. LFC not only fully recovers these losses under the same inference schedule but exceeds the per-frame baseline on both datasets (0.7265 vs. 0.6923; 0.7063 vs. 0.6971), with the largest gains concentrated in Medium and Hard cases. On Colon-Bench, which provides third-party labels never involved in LFC’s supervision, LFC restores skip-frame inference to within 0.39 points of the FBF performance, confirming that the learned compensation generalizes across datasets and label sources rather than overfitting to the training distribution. This supports our interpretation that the compensated frame preserves at least the task-relevant information of a single frame, allowing skip-frame inference to reach, rather than merely approach, per-frame accuracy.
blocks.zh: 表3显示,跳过框架会严重降解TransUNet,在VIM-Polyp和HyperKvasir上,总体Dice分别下降了6.27和9.00个百分点. LFC不仅按照同样的推论时间表完全收回这些损失,而且超过了两个数据集的每个框架基线(0.7265对0.6923;0.7063对0.6971),最大的收益集中于中坚和硬性案例。 在提供从未参与LFC监管的第三方标签的Colon-Bench上,LFC将跳伞推断恢复到FBF业绩的0.39点以内,确认所学的补偿泛指数据集和标签来源,而不是过于适合培训分布. 这支持我们的解释,即补偿框架至少保留一个框架与任务有关的信息,使跳过框架推断能够达到,而不仅仅是接近每个框架的准确性。

blocks.en: For Polyp-PVT (Table 4 ), the picture is different. It attains the strongest frame-by-frame baseline among all three backbones on every dataset, together with the largest number of Easy videos and the lowest prediction jitter, reflecting its task-specific design. Nevertheless, it remains vulnerable to skipping, losing 6.98, 8.37, and 6.51 points under DSF, which shows that a high FBF accuracy alone does not confer robustness to skipping. LFC recovers the majority of the loss on the pseudo-label benchmarks and, on the third-party Colon-Bench, fully restores the FBF performance (0.7649 vs. 0.7616). Its relative gain over FBF is smaller than that of TransUNet, which we analyze in Section 3.5 .
blocks.zh: 对于Polyp-PVT(表4),画面不同. 它在每个数据集的所有三个主干线中实现最强的逐帧基线,同时获得数量最多的Easy视频和最少的预测快感,反映了它的任务设计。 尽管如此,它仍然容易跳过,在DSF下损失6.98,8.37和6.51分,这表明单靠FBF的高精度并不能使跳过强. LFC以伪标签基准回收大部分损失,在第三方Colon-Bench则完全恢复FBF性能(0.7649对0.7616). 它比FBF的相对收益小于TransUNet,我们在3.5节中对此进行了分析。

On VIM-Polyp, LFC improves the overall Dice from 0.6160 (DSF) to 0.6431, recovering most of a 4.20-point skipping loss, and similar recoveries are observed on HyperKvasir and Colon-Bench. The gain, however, is markedly smaller than on the two Transformer backbones, consistent with the inherent robustness of convolutional architectures analyzed in Section 3.5 .

blocks.en: Finally, Table 6 reports the inference speed measured over 1000 video frames on a single NVIDIA 5090 GPU. Training-free fusion strategies achieve the theoretical 3 × 3\times speedup by invoking the backbone once per three frames. LFC introduces merely 0.07M additional parameters and retains 292.8 FPS ( 2.55 × 2.55\times ) on TransUNet and 427.4 FPS ( 2.05 × 2.05\times ) on Polyp-PVT, confirming that the accuracy recovery is obtained at only a modest cost of the skip-frame throughput, across backbones of very different capacities.
blocks.zh: 最后,表6报告了单NVIDIA 5090 GPU上测量的1000多个视频帧的推论速度. 无训练聚变策略实现理论3×3\时速加速,每三帧一次援引主干. LFC在TransUNet上仅引入0.07M附加参数并保留292.8 FPS(2.55×2.55\times),在Polyp-PVT上保留427.4 FPS(2.05×2.05\times),证实精度回收仅以跳伞吞吐量的微薄成本获得,跨不同能力的骨干.

blocks.en: Table 6: Inference efficiency of different frame-skipping strategies on two backbones.
blocks.zh: 表6:两根主干线上不同套帧策略的推论效率.

blocks.en: 3.5 An architectural spectrum of temporal stability under frame skipping
blocks.zh: 3.5 国家 框架下时间稳定性的建筑范围跳过

blocks.en: We now analyze why LFC compensates the three backbones to different extents. Two factors jointly determine the effectiveness of compensation: how strongly a backbone is affected by frame-to-frame jitter artifacts, and how accurate its own predictions are in the first place. Table 7 isolates the first factor. Under the same cross-seed pseudo-label protocol on VIM-Polyp and HyperKvasir, TransUNet exhibits the highest per-video frame-wise Dice standard deviation, indicating that its predictions fluctuate the most under jitter. This aligns with the mechanism discussed above: hard patch partitioning and global self-attention propagate misaligned tokens to the entire feature space. The stronger the jitter sensitivity, the more room LFC has to recover, which explains why LFC benefits TransUNet the most.
blocks.zh: 我们现在分析为什么LFC对三个骨干进行不同程度的补偿. 两个因素共同决定了补偿的有效性:一个骨干受到帧对帧的焦急文物的强烈影响,以及它自己的预测在一开始有多准确. 表7隔离了第一个因素。 在VIM-Polyp和HyperKvasir的同一交叉种子伪标签协议下,Trans UNet显示每帧Dice标准偏差最高,表明其预测波动幅度最大。 这与上文讨论的机制相一致:硬补丁分割和全球自觉向整个特征空间传播错配符。 紧张的敏感度越强,LFC就越需要恢复,这解释了为什么LFC有利于Trans {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}请多多关照

blocks.en: ResNet-UNet shows a lower standard deviation, but this should not be read as superior temporal robustness. Its stability is confounded by two facts: the local smoothing effect of convolutions inherently absorbs mild input perturbations, and its absolute segmentation accuracy is markedly lower than the other two backbones, so its predictions have less accuracy to lose. Its smaller DSF loss and smaller LFC gain are therefore consistent with a less accurate, but inherently less sensitive model.
blocks.zh: ResNet-UNet显示标准偏差较低,但这不应被解读为优于时间强度. 其稳定性被两个事实所混淆:曲折的局部平滑效应内在吸收轻度输入扰动,其绝对分化精度明显低于其他两个骨干,因此其预测的精度损失较少. 因此,其较小的DSF损失和较小的LFC增益与一个不太准确但本质上不太敏感的模型一致.

blocks.en: Polyp-PVT occupies the other end. It achieves the highest overall FBF Dice on all three datasets, the lowest prediction jitter on both video benchmarks, and the largest number of Easy videos. It is already accurate and robust before any compensation. Consequently, the marginal benefit of fusing three frames into one is limited: LFC still substantially recovers the skipping loss on the pseudo-label benchmarks and matches the FBF performance on the third-party Colon-Bench labels, but its relative gain over an already strong FBF baseline is naturally smaller than that on TransUNet. In short, the compensation gain of LFC is inversely related to how much accuracy and stability a backbone already possesses, which is exactly what the spectrum in Table 7 reveals.
blocks.zh: Polyp-PVT占据另一端。 它在所有三个数据集上实现了FBF Dice总体最高,在两个视频基准上都实现了最低的预测焦躁,以及Easy视频数量最多. 在作出任何赔偿之前,它已经是准确和有力的。 因此,将三个框架组合成一个的边际好处有限: LFC仍然大量回收假标签基准上的跳过损失,并与第三方Colon-Bench标签上的FBF性能相匹配,但其相对于已经很强的FBF基线的相对收益自然小于TransUNet. 简言之,LFC的补偿收益与一个骨干已经拥有的准确性和稳定性有反向关系,这正是表7中的频谱所揭示的.

blocks.en: Table 7: Frame-to-frame prediction stability measured by per-video Dice standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 表7:按每段视频测得的帧至帧预测稳定性 Dice标准偏差.

blocks.en: 3.6 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 3.6 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 8 ablates the two core components of LFC on the frozen TransUNet backbone. The spatial attention is the primary source of the compensation gain: removing it consistently degrades performance on both datasets (VIM-Polyp: 0.7265 to 0.7241; HyperKvasir: 0.7063 to 0.7022), which confirms that pixel-level adaptive weighting of the three frames, rather than the fusion head, accounts for the implicit motion compensation. The role of the multi-layer fusion head is dataset-dependent. It contributes a clear gain on the in-domain VIM-Polyp test set (0.7265 vs. 0.7013 without it), particularly in Medium and Hard cases, whereas on the zero-shot HyperKvasir set the configuration without the fusion head performs comparably (0.7170 vs. 0.7063). A plausible explanation is that the additional non-linear capacity helps resolve difficult, low-quality frames seen during training but offers less benefit when the input distribution shifts. Removing both components causes a severe collapse on both datasets (0.6714 and 0.6185), showing that a lightweight encoder alone cannot learn meaningful temporal fusion.
blocks.zh: 表8将冷冻的TransUNet主干线上的LFC的两个核心组件进行消化. 空间关注是补偿收益的主要来源:移除它持续地降低两个数据集上的性能(VIM-Polyp:0.7265–0.7241;HyperKvasir:0.7063–0.7022),这证实了三帧的像素级适应性加权,而不是聚变头,是隐含运动补偿的原因. 多层聚变头的作用依赖于数据集. 它对域内VIM-Polyp测试集(0.7265 vs. 0.7013没有它)有明显的收益,特别是在中坚和硬的案例中,而在零射速HyperKvasir设置时,没有聚变头的配置可比较性能(0.7170 vs. 0.7063). 一个合理的解释是,额外的非线性能力有助于解决培训期间看到的困难、低质量的框架,但当投入分配转移时,其好处较少。 移除这两个组件都会使两个数据集(0.6714和0.6185)发生严重崩溃,表明光是轻量级编码器无法学习有意义的时间聚变.

blocks.en: We retain the complete LFC structure for two reasons. First, the full model achieves the best average performance across the two evaluation sets (0.7164 vs. 0.7132, 0.7092, and 0.6450 for the other variants), and in deployment the in-domain behavior is typically the primary concern. Second, the fusion head does not hurt zero-shot performance beyond a marginal difference, whereas its absence notably degrades in-domain accuracy. The full configuration therefore offers the most reliable trade-off across domains.
blocks.zh: 我们保留完整的LFC结构有两个原因. 第一,整个模式在两个评价组(0.7164对0.7132,0.7092,其他变种0.6450)中取得了最佳平均业绩,在部署中,域内行为通常是主要关切问题。 第二,聚变头不会伤害到超出边际差的零射性能,而它的缺失则明显地降解了域内精度. 因此,完整的配置为各个领域提供了最可靠的权衡。

blocks.en: Table 8: Ablation study of LFC components on TransUNet under frame-skipping inference ( K K =3).
blocks.zh: 表8:在帧吸附推论(K K = 3)下对TransUNet上的LFC元件进行放大研究.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we present LFC, a lightweight plug-and-play module for accurate skip-frame polyp segmentation in endoscopic videos. Inserted before a frozen segmentation backbone and trained only on cross-seed pseudo-labels, LFC fuses a three-frame window into a single compensated frame through spatio-temporal attention, recovering most of the accuracy loss caused by frame skipping while retaining a 2.05 × \times –2.55 × \times throughput gain over per-frame inference. Cross-dataset validation confirms that the learned temporal fusion generalizes beyond the training distribution rather than overfitting to a specific dataset, and in several settings the compensated predictions even reach the accuracy of frame-by-frame inference, indicating that temporal fusion also acts as implicit denoising.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了LFC,一个轻量级的插座和游戏模块,用于在内视视频中精确的跳伞多面分解. LFC在被冻结的分块主干之前插入,并且只接受过交叉种子假标签的培训,通过时空注意将一个三帧窗口装入一个单一补偿框架,回收大部分因帧跳过而导致的准确性损失,同时保留2.05xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 跨数据集验证确认,所学的时间聚变一般化超出了训练分布,而不是过度适应特定数据集,在多个场合,补偿预测甚至达到逐帧推论的准确性,表明时间聚变也起到暗含去诺的作用.

blocks.en: Our analysis across three backbones further reveals an architectural spectrum of temporal stability under frame skipping. The compensation gain of LFC is governed by two factors, namely the sensitivity of the backbone to frame-to-frame jitter artifacts and its own prediction accuracy: global self-attention propagates misaligned patches across the entire feature space, making TransUNet both the most sensitive and the largest beneficiary of compensation, whereas the pyramid structure and strong accuracy of Polyp-PVT leave less room for improvement, and the convolutional smoothing of ResNet-UNet provides partial inherent robustness. LFC is therefore of greatest value for high-capacity Transformer backbones, which achieve the best static accuracy but suffer the most under skip-frame inference. As a generalizable temporal compensation strategy, LFC is readily applicable to other surgical endoscopic video tasks beyond polyp segmentation. Future work will extend LFC to laparoscopic and bronchoscopic video analysis and explore adaptive skip strategies.
blocks.zh: 我们对三个支柱的分析进一步揭示了框架跳过时段稳定的建筑范围。 LFC的补偿收益受到两个因素的制约,即主干对帧对帧的焦急文物的敏感性及其自身的预测准确性:全球自觉在整个特征空间传播错配的补丁,使Trans 将补偿的最敏感和最大的受益者统一起来,而Polyp-PVT的金字塔结构和强精度没有多少改进余地,ResNet-UNet的逐步平滑提供了部分固有的坚固性。 因此,LFC对于大功率变形器骨干来说价值最大,它们能达到最佳的静态精度,但受跳伞推断的影响最大. 作为一般的时间补偿战略,LFC很容易适用于除多聚分化之外的其他外科内视视频任务。 未来的工作将扩展LFC,使之包括脑膜和支气管视频分析,并探索适应性跳伞策略。
